method_outcomes.B2: Refuted the invented necessary condition that raw D must be semialgebraic: a dense rational-direction cone has full projective closure and therefore ordinary polytope hulls. Also proved a semialgebraic boundary cannot contain open 2D patches in infinitely many distinct affine planes, and isolated generic noncoincidence as only one part of a future wildness proof.
method_outcomes.B18: Proved projective-closure invariance for spanning D and an exact finite-dimensional Jensen-weight dual characterization of finite-set hull membership. This reframes positive semialgebraicity as finite semialgebraic elimination for the Jensen-weight relation; novelty of the convex-duality formulation is not claimed.
method_outcomes.B30: Proved exact affine-coset/span reduction, the two-point dichotomy, and complete semialgebraicity for dim span(D)<=1. These are proper-subclass results and do not move the source-complete metric.

new_exact_results: Functional D-convexity and hulls depend only on the closed projective direction set Omega_D
Two-point dichotomy: segment iff the connecting direction lies in Omega_D, otherwise just the two endpoints
All finite collinear hulls exactly classified; every cone with span dimension <=1 has semialgebraic finite hulls
Finite-dimensional Jensen-weight separation criterion for membership
Infinite pairwise-distinct open planar boundary patches obstruct semialgebraicity
